enum E { A = 1, B = 1, C = 2 }
const x: E.B = E.A;
function f(y: E.A) { return y; }
console.log(x, f(E.B));
const z: E.C = E.A;
namespace N { export enum F { A = 1 } }
const a = E.A as const;
const b = N.F.A as const;
const c = E["C"] as const;
const k = E.A;
const d = k as const;
enum Color { Red, Green }
namespace Color {
  export interface Pair { first: Color; second: Color }
  export type Opt = number | undefined;
  export const make = (): Pair => ({ first: Color.Red, second: Color.Green });
}
const p: Color.Pair = Color.make();
const o: Color.Opt = 1;
const r: Color.Red = Color.Red;
console.log(a, b, c, d, p.first, p.second, o, r);
